welcome_offer.description: Earn up to 60,000 bonus points with purchases of $15,000 in the first 6 months: 30,000 World of Hyatt bonus points after spending $3,000 in the first 3 months, plus up to 30,000 more by earning 2 bonus points total per $1 on purchases that normally earn 1 point, on up to $15,000 spent in the first 6 months.
notes: Chase issuer page verified 2026-08-22: 30,000 points after $3,000/3mo plus up to 30,000 points through temporary extra earning on up to $15,000 in the first 6 months.
The prior elevated 75,000-point offer expired on 2026-08-20; Chase now displays the standard up-to-60,000-point public offer.

sources.notes: Official Chase page checked 2026-10-02: up to 60,000 bonus points (30k after $3k in 3 months + up to 30k more at 2x on up to $15k in 6 months); $95 annual fee.

recurring_credits.name: DoorDash Non-Restaurant Credit
recurring_credits.description: $10/quarter ($40/year) at checkout on one qualifying non-restaurant DoorDash order. Requires DashPass enrollment.

recurring_credits.name: Free Night Award (Hyatt Cat 1-4)
recurring_credits.description: 1 Free Night Award at any Hyatt Cat 1-4 property each cardmember anniversary. No assigned USD value (varies by property/season).

welcome_bonus.notes: Up to 60,000 points possible (30K + 30K from 2x on $15,000 spend)
